    About Vinci

    We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

    As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations.     By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs.     Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior.     Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware.     Jouw impact bij Movares

    Vergroot je kennis van stalen bruggen en help ons verder met actuele vraagstukken rond vermoeiing en stabiliteit.

    Dit ga je doen bij Movares

    • Verdiep je in de theorie over vermoeiing en stabiliteit van stalen bruggen.

    • Onderzoek een technisch vraagstuk dat je samen met je begeleider afstemt.

    • Bedenk en vergelijk oplossingen voor het gekozen vraagstuk.

    • Werk je aanpak, berekeningen, resultaten en conclusies uit in een helder verslag.

    • Draag met jouw onderzoek bij aan het verbreden van de kennis binnen de afdeling.

    Veel stalen bruggen uit de jaren 60 en 70 zijn toe aan renovatie of vervanging. Daarbij zijn vermoeiing en stabiliteit belangrijke technische thema’s. Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je één van deze onderwerpen. De precieze opdracht stemmen we samen af. Zo verdiep je jouw technische kennis en lever je kennis op die het team kan gebruiken bij complexe bruggen en constructies.

    Dit ben jij bij Movares

    Voor deze vacature breng jij mee:

    • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding Civiele Techniek.

    • Je onderzoekt technische vraagstukken zorgvuldig en onderbouwt je keuzes.

    • Je denkt in oplossingen en vergelijkt verschillende mogelijkheden.

    • Je legt je aanpak, resultaten en conclusies duidelijk en gestructureerd vast.

    Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiairs. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren. En ook als lid van Young Movares, onze jongerenvereniging, staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

    Dit krijg je bij Movares

    Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer, je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en je krijgt een goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:

    • Een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

    • Ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;

    • Leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht.

    En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook:

    • Bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stage loopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;

    • Lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

    Jouw team bij Movares

    Voor jou als afstudeerstagiair(e) bij Civiele Constructies is er plek op onze afdeling Civiele Constructies in team Staal.

    Je werkt in een jong team van 12 constructeurs. Samen rekenen jullie aan complexe bruggen en andere constructies. Het team gebruikt actuele rekentools, waarvan een deel zelf is ontwikkeld. De projecten zijn vaak integraal en multidisciplinair. Daardoor heb je tijdens je afstudeerstage contact met collega’s uit verschillende vakgebieden. Je krijgt de ruimte om je te verdiepen in stalen constructies en jouw kennis verder te ontwikkelen. Met jouw onderzoek draag je tegelijk bij aan de kennis binnen het team.

Discover What’s Possible at BetMGM

Ready to make your career legendary? Join us as we bring the magic of Vegas to our players. The BetMGM team has over 1,400 talented members, revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We’re a brand with technology at our hearts and the most driven and focused talent in the business.

As a valued team member, we’re committed to giving you the resources and support you need to thrive. Our benefits and perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities

  • Employee resource groups

  • Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win.

The Opportunity

About the Role

The Director defines and drives the overall strategy and vision for Risk Operations teams who primarily work in a contact center environment handling both inbound live customer contacts as well as internally-generated workflows. Through effective leadership, the Director fosters a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and innovation that continually elevate the customer experience in alignment with his/her vision.

This multi-national team triages responsible gambling concerns, resolves payment inquiries, reviews cases related to Know Your Customer (KYC), Source of Funds (SOF), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Responsible Gaming (RG) concerns, as well as other functions that protect both our Players and our company. Our Risk, Fraud and Payment Operations teams protect our customers by verifying identity, ensure deposits and withdrawals are safe, fast, efficient, and cost-effective while simultaneously securing player accounts and, in partnership with several stakeholders, making BetMGM a place to game responsibly.

This role proactively works with individuals across the organization to influence process and policy decisions, advocate for the needs of their team, and drive customer centric interactions that exceed expectations.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Craft and execute a comprehensive plan that ensures continuous, uninterrupted contact center operations for all Risk teams
  • Directly manage exempt and non-exempt staff who oversee several hundred contact center agents located across the U.S. and internationally
  • Define a holistic Risk Operations strategy with a view toward enterprise systems/structures, handling protocols, required tooling, and rules of engagement between/across organizational teams that aligns to your vision for the player experience for this group
  • Partner with key stakeholders including Customer Care, Workforce Management, QA, Training, Product, Compliance, Legal, and others to formulate strategic and tactical plans for the Risk Operations group
  • Define and manage to KPIs that assess operational and performance excellence for your teams
  • Create and manage processes and procedures around accesses on BetMGM platform and safeguard controls around the network
  • Partner with functions to assess risk regarding new bonus campaigns and providing Risk knowledge and support to the Marketing Operations teams
  • Using defined KPIs and troves of Company and Player information, make data-driven decisions to lead your business and drive operational efficiency
  • Ensure compliance with various regulatory requirements, including internal & external reporting, account risk and fraud reviews, responding to regulator and patron complaints before deadline, etc.
  • Build reporting, dashboards, and conduct data analyses as needed by the business
  • Manage Risk-specific operations including KYC processes and procedures while also partnering with internal stakeholders to continually optimize processes related to deposits, cash outs, chargebacks, payment disputes and recovery of funds.
  • Take an active role in BetMGM strategic projects by ensuring Risk Operations requirements are contemplated
  • Manage the process of handling compliance issues by utilizing appropriate resources to investigate and resolve matters with minimal customer friction
  • Minimize potential business losses by challenging disputed transactions (e.g. liaising with the relevant Banks/Payment methods) and improving internal controls where needed
  • Guide your teams in best practices related to tracking, adapting to, intercepting, and acting upon suspicious and/or suspected fraudulent account activity
  • Provide Responsible Gaming reviews of customer accounts and ensure operational teams and the business are protected

What You Bring to the Table (Qualifications)

  • Must be or become licensed through the appropriate Gaming jurisdictions as a condition of hire and continued employment. Based on this role, you may also be required and be eligible to hold more advanced and comprehensive licenses.
  • 7+ years leading medium-to-large contact centers (e.g. 300 seats or more)
  • 5+ years working in a highly regulated industry with a strong preference for experience in the gaming/gambling industry
  • 5+ years leading Risk, Fraud, and/or Payment Operations teams in a contact center or comparable production environment
  • Experience leading blended direct and outsourced teams to achieve results across multiple geographies
  • Practical experience with various online marketing incentives
  • Knowledge and experience of AML, KYC, and SOF best practices
  • Leadership skills, proven experience of managing teams

Who You Are (Essential Requirements)

  • Be a culture-builder, leveraging the organization’s passion for serving our players and Team Members across regulated jurisdictions
  • Influencing skills are essential. BetMGM is not a command-and-control environment
  • An exceptional leader experienced in coaching and developing talent.  Able to set a vision and motivate a team to reach a goal while creating a fun and productive culture
  • We continue to innovate and may not have all the systems and tools and people in place. A successful candidate will be comfortable with that level of ambiguity and thrive on the challenge of defining the tools we still need while driving the business forward as we build underlying capabilities.
  • We value transparency. There is no “me” culture. Communication and collaboration across the entire team will lead to greater individual and collective success

​

Compensation

The annual salary range for this position is $137,200.00 to $180,075.00. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for participation in a performance-based bonus plan.

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc.

Compensation


The pay range for this position is as follows:


137,200.00--182,900.00

Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for participation in a performance-based bonus plan.

Gaming Compliance & Licensing Requirements

As an online gaming company, BetMGM is required to comply with state gaming regulations which includes licensing obligations. Applicable employees must be licensed by at least one jurisdictional agency, although certain positions require licensing by multiple agencies. Failure to become licensed or maintain licensure with each agency as required for the role may result in termination of employment. Please note that the licensing process includes comprehensive background checks which may include a review of criminal records, financial history, and personal background verification.

In addition, candidates must comply with and support BetMGM's responsible gambling policies, procedures, and initiatives.

About BetMGM

BetMGM is revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We are a partnership between two powerhouse organizations—MGM Resorts International and Entain Group. You know our name through our exciting portfolio of brands including BetMGM Casino, BetMGM Sportsbook, Borgata Online, Party Casino and Party Poker. We aim to bring our ideas into action and find ways to deliver the best quality in gaming platforms.

BetMGM LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. As an organization, we are unwavering in our commitment to maintaining a discrimination-free work environment, and fostering a culture of inclusivity, belonging and equal opportunity for all employees and applicants.

If you need assistance or accommodation with your application due to a disability, you may contact us at .

Ecolab's Food & Beverage division is seeking a Technical Excellence Specialist to support the Brewery & Beverage market in the Nordics. Our local team delivers hygiene solutions that help Nordic Food & Beverage manufacturers tackle their biggest challenges and reach their targets.


What’s in it for you:

  • Join our European Brewery & Beverage Technical Excellence Team and work closely together with your European colleagues who are all experts in the field of Brewery & Beverage.
  • Play a key role in helping customers focus on what they do best – producing safe food – by understanding their needs, developing tailored solutions and driving innovation initiatives.
  • Work directly with the Nordic sales organisation, supporting them in customer engagements.
  • Enjoy flexible working hours.
  • Receive an attractive salary and benefits package.

What you will do:

  • Technical Expertise – Act as the technical expert for the product portfolio and cleaning & sanitation applications across the Nordic market.
  • Customer Support & Problem Solving – Conduct audits, provide hygiene advice, troubleshoot sanitation, product-quality and microbial-safety issues, and develop effective cleaning solutions.
  • CIP & Application Optimisation – Validate and optimise customer CIP processes and support applications in production and bottling areas.
  • Sales & Growth Support – Support Corporate Accounts and Field Sales on key GTW opportunities through field trials, technical assessments, calculations, reports and solution development.
  • TVD & Value Creation – Identify and implement Total Value Delivered (TVD) projects using best practices and application expertise to deliver measurable customer savings.
  • Product & Programme Implementation – Support surveys, proposal development, start-ups, optimisation, conversions and the introduction of new products and programmes.
  • Training & Capability Building – Deliver technical training to Food & Beverage teams and customers on sanitation programmes, product applications and structured problem solving.
  • Industry & Technical Network – Build relationships with customers, universities, industry associations and suppliers, while staying current on new technologies, technical developments and regulatory requirements.

Location & Travel Requirements:

  • Remote role covering the Nordics, ideally based in the Greater Copenhagen area, Denmark.
  • The role involves at least 40% travel in Denmark and the wider Nordics to provide on-site technical support and advice to colleagues and customers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A 5-year degree or equivalent in the field of Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry or Food Processing.
  • Preferably 5 to 10 years' experience in the Brewery, Beverage or Dairy industry and familiar with terms as CIP, conveyor lubrication and filler cleaning.
  • Solid knowledge of basic chemistry and microbiology
  • A strong interest in the Food & Beverage market, ideally within breweries and soft drinks.
  • A valid driver license.
  • A collaborative team player who adds value with individual perspective.
  • An analytical mindset and a natural problem-solver.
  • Confident using reporting tools and AI.

Application deadline:

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About the Team

Our AI Enablement team drives enterprise-wide adoption of generative AI, spanning platform engineering, governance, and hands-on delivery of AI-powered products and internal tooling. The team builds and operates the infrastructure, integrations, and knowledge systems that let engineering and business teams safely adopt large language models at scale. The Lead AI Engineer joins as the senior technical authority on this team, setting the architectural direction that Senior and Associate AI Engineers build against.


Position Summary

The Lead AI Engineer provides technical leadership and architecture ownership for the company's AI platform and its embedded delivery initiatives, operating one level above the Senior AI Engineer role. This person owns the technical design of agentic and LLM-powered systems built on large language model APIs, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/connector integration, and evaluation/governance tooling, in a highly regulated healthcare environment. The Lead AI Engineer sets architectural standards across AI-embedded product delivery, mentors Senior and Associate AI Engineers, and represents AI platform architecture to engineering leadership and Legal/Compliance/Privacy.

Success is measured by the reliability, security, and scalability of the AI systems shipped, the rate at which Senior/Associate engineers adopt the architectural standards this role sets, and this role's influence on AI platform decisions across the organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI Architecture Leadership: Define the technical architecture and roadmap for LLM/agentic systems — model routing across cloud AI platforms, connector/integration patterns, RAG pipelines, and prompt/evaluation frameworks.
  • Solution Design & Governance: Lead architecture reviews for new AI capabilities and ensure designs meet enterprise security, privacy, and data-provenance requirements.
  • Platform Ownership: Drive the technical design of shared AI platform capabilities, including knowledge-retrieval systems, citation/traceability of AI-generated outputs, and permission-aware access to data.
  • Hands-On Delivery: Personally architect and build high-complexity components on priority AI delivery initiatives where a working system, not just a design doc, is the deliverable.
  • Technical Mentorship: Set coding, architecture, and evaluation standards for Senior and Associate AI Engineers; run design reviews and pair on complex agentic workflows.
  • LLMOps & Responsible AI: Establish secure, observable, and cost-attributed AI operations — usage/spend attribution, abuse monitoring, model evaluation, and rollback strategy — for production LLM systems.

Description/Responsibilities

This role serves as a force multiplier for the Sales organization across all core product lines, including SilverSneakers, ForeverFit, and WholeHealth Living, by accelerating partner-enabled pursuits, centralizing deep partner expertise, and activating onboarded partners and newly sold ASO or channel relationships to create pipeline, subscriptions, and measurable growth.

In this role you will lead the revenue realization phase of strategic partnerships, ASO relationships, and channel agreements. The role operates across SilverSneakers, ForeverFit, and WholeHealth Living. This is a senior, hands-on sales role focused on what happens after a partner enters the ecosystem or a new channel relationship is sold: activating the partner’s sales organization, advancing the second and third sale, and generating subscriptions and revenue from the end user market.

The role is intentionally distinct from partnership sourcing and contracting, which remains with the VP of Strategic Growth & Partnerships, and from enterprise-wide sales enablement, which remains with GTM Operations. The Senior Director will use the foundation those teams create and apply it directly within each assigned partner engagement to build pipeline, remove barriers, and deliver against commercial targets. This role will partner closely with the VP of Channel Partner Sales and the broader Sales Team to drive activation within customers sold.

The ideal candidate combines channel sales leadership, consultative selling, customer and market insight, operational discipline, and strong analytics. This leader will work directly with partner sales team members, Strategy, GTM Operations, Product, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Client Relations to turn signed relationships and approved solutions into repeatable, measurable growth.

A core purpose of this role is to accelerate the speed and effectiveness of Tivity Health sellers. The Senior Director becomes the go-to sales resource for partner capabilities, value propositions, pricing, commercial terms, integration considerations, and contract parameters, helping sellers quickly determine when and how to bring the right partner into a pursuit without requiring every seller to master every partner offering.

What You’ll Do

Own Partner and Channel Revenue Pull-Through

  • Assume commercial activation responsibility once a strategic partner is onboarded or a new ASO or channel relationship is sold and ready for market activation.• Create an engagement-specific revenue activation plan that defines target segments, pipeline goals, activities, milestones, decision points, risks, and owners.• Activate the salesforce of the ASO, channel partner, or strategic partner so its sellers can identify, position, and advance Tivity Health opportunities with confidence.• Drive the second sale to the partner’s field organization and the third sale to employer groups, health plan clients, consumers, or other end users, depending on the channel model.• Build relationships with partner sales leaders and frontline sellers while coordinating with the VP of Strategic Growth & Partnerships on partner governance and relationship priorities.• Lead or support joint operating committees and commercial activation forums for assigned relationships, with clear agendas, decisions, accountability, and follow-through.• Develop creative business development and market outreach approaches for prospective customers already accessible through existing ASO or channel relationships.

Accelerate Sales Through Partner Expertise

  • Apply partner expertise and sales activation support across all customer segments and core Tivity Health product lines: SilverSneakers, ForeverFit, and WholeHealth Living.• Serve as the Sales organization’s subject-matter expert on Tivity Health’s partner ecosystem, providing sellers with a single point of expertise for how and when partner capabilities should be brought into active sales pursuits.• Develop and maintain a deep working knowledge of each partner’s value proposition, capabilities, target market, use cases, pricing, commercial terms, integration requirements, implementation considerations, and relevant contractual parameters.• Quickly assess customer needs and active opportunities to determine whether a partner capability can strengthen the pursuit, and bring the appropriate partner into the sales process at the right time.• Work directly alongside Sales on partner-enabled opportunities so individual sellers can remain focused on the customer relationship, discovery, and advancing the sale rather than independently mastering every partner offering.• Translate complex partner information into clear, actionable guidance for sellers, including what the partner does, where the partner adds value, how the offering is positioned, what it costs, how it integrates, and what is required to advance the opportunity.• Coordinate with the appropriate internal and partner resources to answer questions quickly, resolve dependencies, and remove barriers that could slow an active sales pursuit.• Identify opportunities where partner capabilities can strengthen the customer value proposition and coordinate the appropriate experts to support the pursuit.• Maintain continuity across partner-enabled pursuits so recurring questions, objections, integration considerations, and successful approaches can be applied to future opportunities.• Partner with GTM Operations to ensure recurring field questions and knowledge gaps inform broader sales tools, materials, and enablement, while keeping this role focused on deal-level execution and acceleration.• Capture customer and seller feedback from active pursuits and route it to the appropriate Strategy, Product, Strategic Growth & Partnerships, and GTM Operations owners without assuming ownership of those functions.

Advance Strategic and Complex Sales Opportunities

  • Work alongside Tivity Health and partner sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance high-value opportunities through the sales cycle.• Lead consultative discovery for complex or client-specific opportunities, with particular focus on strategic accounts where customization, coordination, or nonstandard operating requirements may be needed.• Translate customer objectives into a clear, commercially viable approach using approved product capabilities and partner solutions, without duplicating Product or Operations ownership.• Coordinate the right internal experts across Strategy, Product, Finance, Operations, Network, Legal, Marketing, and Client Relations to resolve dependencies and move opportunities forward.• Create client-specific pursuit plans, value stories, proposal inputs, executive presentations, and close strategies using the core materials and tools established by GTM Operations.• Maintain continuity from the proposed commercial solution through contracting, implementation, launch, and transition to ongoing account management.

Drive Growth Across the Customer Lifecycle

  • Support expansion and renewal opportunities when the solution, value proposition, commercial model, or delivery approach is changing.• Partner with Client Relations to identify whitespace, expansion paths, adoption barriers, and new use cases within existing partner and customer relationships.• Help translate partner and customer performance into a forward-looking growth plan focused on subscriptions, utilization, revenue, retention, and long-term value.• Work with partner and internal teams to address commercial friction, clarify ownership, and accelerate decisions without taking over implementation or service delivery responsibilities.

Use Analytics to Manage Performance and Value

  • Establish measurable targets and scorecards for each assigned engagement, including leading and lagging indicators appropriate to the commercial model.• Track partner activation, seller participation, training completion, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, conversion, subscriptions, revenue, and other agreed outcomes.• Analyze performance against targets, identify gaps and root causes, and recommend corrective actions to partner and Tivity Health leaders.• Provide clear reporting, forecasts, and executive-level insights that show progress, risks, expected value, and decisions needed.• Build evidence-based value narratives that connect partner activities and customer outcomes to measurable commercial impact.

Bring the Voice of the Customer and Market Back to Tivity Health

  • Capture structured feedback directly from partner sellers, customers, consultants, brokers, and the market during active pursuits and post-launch growth efforts.• Maintain a direct feedback loop with Strategy, Product, Sales, and GTM Operations so field insights inform priorities, positioning, enablement, and future capabilities.• Provide the Strategy team with actionable market intelligence while preserving Strategy’s ownership of broader portfolio direction and partner strategy.• Recommend improvements to messaging, sales plays, product capabilities, commercial models, and operating processes based on observed market needs and performance data.• Participate in relevant steering committees and working teams when assigned, contributing frontline commercial evidence without replacing existing functional ownership.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in channel sales, partner activation, business development, strategic account growth, consultative sales, or commercial execution within health care, employer benefits, fitness, well-being, or a related industry.• Demonstrated success converting signed partnerships or channel relationships into pipeline, subscriptions, and revenue.• Experience selling through ASO health plans, consultants, brokers, benefits platforms, strategic partners, distribution partners, or large employers.• Strong analytics capability, including target setting, scorecard design, pipeline inspection, forecasting, performance analysis, and executive reporting.• Ability to train, coach, and activate external sales organizations while directly supporting priority pursuits.• Experience leading complex, client-specific opportunities that require cross-functional coordination, thoughtful customization, and clear commercial judgment.• Ability to distinguish between standard enablement, partner relationship ownership, sales execution, product decisions, implementation, and ongoing account management, and to collaborate effectively across those boundaries.• Strong understanding of SilverSneakers, ForeverFit, and WholeHealth Living and how customer needs, product capabilities, operational requirements, pricing, economics, and partner models come together in a viable commercial solution.• Executive presence and the ability to build credibility with partner leaders, sellers, customers, and senior internal stakeholders.• A strong bias toward action, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to create momentum in complex or ambiguous situations.• Exceptional communication, presentation, relationship-building, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Revenue, subscriptions, and pipeline generated through assigned ASO, channel, and strategic partner engagements.• Progress against engagement-specific commercial targets, milestones, and forecasts.• Activation and productivity of partner sales teams, including seller readiness, participation, opportunity creation, and advancement.• Successful second and third sales that move an onboarded relationship from contract to partner adoption and end-user growth.• Conversion and velocity of strategic or complex opportunities supported by the role.• Expansion and renewal results where the role supports a new solution, changed value proposition, or sales activation need.• Quality, timeliness, and actionability of reporting, market intelligence, customer insight, and recommendations.• Clear cross-functional ownership and effective collaboration with Strategic Growth & Partnerships, GTM Operations, Sales, Strategy, Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Legal, Network, and Client Relations.• Repeatability of partner activation plans, sales plays, scorecards, and commercial operating rhythms across engagements.• Speed and effectiveness across SilverSneakers, ForeverFit, and WholeHealth Living of partner-enabled sales pursuits, including the ability to quickly match customer needs with the right partner capabilities and remove partner-related barriers for sellers.

Job Description:

CDI Outsourcing Manager- Remote(Solventum)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As a CDI Outsourcing Manager, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Assume responsibility/overall management for the assigned outsourced CDI engagements that are either supplemental or total outsourced programs while assisting Consulting Services in obtaining set revenue goals.

  • Monitors and manages relationships with contracted vendors and facilitates the resolution of issues and conflicts

  • Directly supervise and provide expertise to the CDI staff to assure target quality and production levels

  • Continually measure the effectiveness of CDI operations, identify areas for improvement, monitor trends and develop plans of action for and any identified problem areas

  • Provides direct supervision to assigned CDI through leadership, coaching, training and development, allocating work assignments, review of progress in achieving objectives, managing employee compensation, performance appraisals, diversity, disability, all relevant employee data, etc. Understands and enforces corporate/location policies and procedures. Takes appropriate action to address policy violations.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution

AND seven (7) years of acute care CDI management experience.

OR

  • High School Diploma/GED from AND eleven (11) years of acute care CDI management experience.

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • CCDS certification or valid RN license with minimum of five (5) years acute care experience

  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Master's degree in HIM, Nursing, or other healthcare clinical background from an accredited institution

  • Preferred 10+ years in management of CDI or Health Information Management (HIM) services consulting or coding functions in mid-to-large size acute care hospital setting or 10+ years in management of outsourced CDI group

  • Strong ICD-10-CM/PCS coding, ICD-10-CM/PCS Coding Guidelines and DRG methodologies experience; Working knowledge of risk-adjusted methodologies (e.g., APR DRGs) and quality of care measures (e.g., HACs, PSIs)

  • Deep understanding of clinical documentation, medical record coding, healthcare billing and revenue cycle management

  • Attention to detail, highly organized, with an absolute focus on quality of work. Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, work independently and produce excellent results

Work location:

  • Remote

Travel: May include up to 50% domestic

Relocation Assistance: Not authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, and empathetic Bankruptcy Attorney to manage consumer and/or commercial bankruptcy cases from inception through discharge. The attorney must be capable of working within our operating environment (e.g., use of CRM System, time reporting, client support, etc.). The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in the U.S. Bankruptcy Code, navigating Chapter 7, 11, and 13 proceedings (immediately Chapter 11 for non-individuals). You will be responsible for advising clients facing severe financial distress, safeguarding their rights against predatory collections, and guiding them toward lasting financial recovery. This role requires a seamless blend of precise transactional document preparation, sharp courtroom litigation, and compassionate communication. Finally, you must be actively licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of Illinois.

Key Responsibilities

Petition & Schedule Preparation: Draft, review, and file highly technical bankruptcy petitions, schedules of assets/liabilities, statement of financial affairs, and means testing disclosures. Client facing communications are requested, required or expected.

Court Representation: Represent clients at 341 Meetings of Creditors, confirmation hearings, relief from stay motions, and adversarial proceedings.

Creditor Negotiation: Enforce automatic stay provisions, stop stop creditor harassment, and negotiate reaffirmation agreements, lien strip-offs, or modified repayment plans.

Case Management: Utilize electronic filing systems (CM/ECF) and PACER to manage strict federal court deadlines and monitor case progress.

Asset Optimization: Formulate legal strategies utilizing state and federal exemptions to protect client property and assets to the maximum extent permitted by law.

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly.

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever’s tech stack: frameworks used to develop our applications, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure that support our operations.
  • You will have lots of Pull Requests merged and running in production.
  • You will attend some of the Fever Originals’ experiences, like Candlelight.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.
  • You will have participated in the launch of one of our new microservices, from 0 to production.
  • You will mentor other team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • You will participate in some of the team-building we organise for your team or the whole engineering team.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of good practices, testing, and design patterns.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Handling services with high concurrency and high-volume requests.
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • You are proficient in business English

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
    • Base Salary: 50K - 75K EUR
    • Total Compensation: 67K - 90K EUR (Including Base, Variable, and Stock Options)

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

  • Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
  • Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.
  • Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

. Communicating decisions clearly and sensitively, in line with Treating Customers Fairly principles

. Coaching and mentoring colleagues, completing file reviews and supporting technical development

. Building trusted relationships with customers, clients and colleagues

. Contributing to continuous improvement and management information where required

.A minimum of 4 - 5 years’ experience assessing Group Income Protection claims

. Strong experience managing complex and long-term Income Protection cases

. Strong technical knowledge of Group Risk products and policy interpretation

. A good understanding of long-term medical conditions, NHS pathways and rehabilitation processes

. Experience using claims management systems and functional assessments

. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex decisions clearly and sensitively

. A collaborative approach, with a genuine interest in coaching and sharing technical knowledge

At Unum, we’ve created a workplace where people feel supported to progress and grow, and can see their ambitions coming to life.

Join our team as a Quality Assurance Engineer focused on validating next-generation conversational and voice-based customer experience solutions. In this role, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and accuracy of intelligent virtual assistants, voice applications, and customer engagement platforms by testing conversational flows, integrations, automation, and end-to-end customer journeys. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help deliver seamless, high-quality customer experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios for conversational AI, voice, and customer interaction solutions.
  • Validate conversational flows, intent recognition, entities, utterances, response accuracy, escalation paths, and exception handling.
  • Create and maintain automated test suites to improve testing coverage, efficiency, and release quality.
  • Test voice and telephony interactions, including speech recognition, touch-tone inputs, call routing, transfers, and customer journey workflows.
  • Validate integrations between conversational platforms, backend systems, APIs, and third-party services.
  • Perform system-level and user journey testing to ensure seamless customer experiences across multiple channels.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify defects while collaborating closely with developers, solution architects, business analysts, and product teams.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, execution reports, and quality metrics.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and provide quality-focused feedback early in the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure applications meet established quality standards, functional requirements, performance expectations, and customer experience goals.
  • Contribute to test process improvements, automation strategies, and continuous quality initiatives.
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with hands-on experience testing conversational AI, IVR, voice applications, or customer engagement platforms.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Cyara Cruncher, Cyara Velocity, and Cyara Virtual Agent for test design, execution, automation, and reporting.
  • Experience testing conversational AI solutions using AWS Lex and/or Google Dialogflow CX/ES, including intent recognition, conversation flows, and response validation.
  • Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
  • Deep understanding of conversational AI concepts, including NLU, intents, entities, utterances, context management, fallback handling, and escalation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience validating IVR and voice interactions, including speech recognition, DTMF inputs, call routing, transfers, and call termination scenarios.
  • Experience testing APIs, backend integrations, data exchanges, and contact center workflows across enterprise applications.
  • Strong experience in test planning, test case design, defect management, execution reporting, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder collaboration, and documentation skills.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with performance, load, stress, and scalability testing of conversational AI and voice applications.
  • Familiarity with SIP, telephony protocols, speech recognition technologies, DTMF, and call-routing concepts.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks, API testing tools, and CI/CD-enabled QA practices.
  • Exposure to Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, or other contact center platforms.
  • Knowledge of conversational analytics, customer experience monitoring, and AI-driven customer engagement solutions.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding scope, schedule, and budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. With nearly 1,000 full-time professionals and an annual growth rate exceeding 25%, we continue to deliver innovative technology solutions to global enterprises.

VerSprite

VerSprite is an Inc. 5000 2020 fastest growing company and industry leader in PASTA threat modeling. Founded in 2007, VerSprite is a private cybersecurity consulting firm helping organizations tighten their risk-gaps with evolved security solutions and advanced threat intel tools.

VerSprite has a 97% client retention rate providing organizations with services like penetration tests, evolved red teaming engagements, vCISO, vSOC and VerSprite’s advanced security tools Cloud Security Assessment Platform and Cyber Threat Intelligence Portal.

VerSprite is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Manager of Defenders Team to lead and support the delivery of advanced cybersecurity services.

This role requires a leader who combines deep cybersecurity expertise with the ability to leverage frontier AI models and locally deployed AI models to enhance security operations, accelerate investigations, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of security services.

The ideal candidate is a technically skilled professional who can lead a team while remaining actively involved in complex security challenges, technical investigations, and the practical application of AI-driven solutions.

Candidates must be comfortable working flexible hours aligned with U.S. business operations.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Operations & Technical Leadership

  • Lead and provide hands-on technical guidance across the Defenders team's cybersecurity operations and service delivery.

  • Oversee and contribute to threat hunting, threat intelligence, and compromise assessments.

  • Guide digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) activities, including complex investigations and response efforts.

  • Support the delivery and continuous improvement of Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services.

  • Lead and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises (TTXs) to evaluate and strengthen organizational incident response readiness.

  • Conduct and guide in-depth organizational threat modeling research to identify and assess security risks.

  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to cybersecurity professionals.

AI-Driven Security Operations

  • Leverage frontier AI models and locally deployed AI models to enhance cybersecurity investigations, analysis, and service delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI-driven automation across threat hunting, threat intelligence, incident response, and MDR workflows.

  • Evaluate and implement practical AI-assisted approaches to improve operational efficiency and technical capabilities.

  • Guide the responsible integration of AI technologies into cybersecurity processes while maintaining technical accuracy and security standards.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Manage and mentor technically skilled cybersecurity professionals.

  • Balance team leadership responsibilities with active participation in technical work.

  • Collaborate with VerSprite leadership and technical teams to improve security service capabilities.

  • Support the development of effective workflows, technical methodologies, and consistent service delivery practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on technical experience in cybersecurity operations, security engineering, incident response, or closely related disciplines.

  • Demonstrated technical expertise in threat hunting, threat intelligence, compromise assessments, DFIR, or MDR services.

  • Experience applying advanced AI models or locally deployed AI technologies to technical or security-related workflows.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, investigative methodologies, and defensive security practices.

  • Ability to lead and mentor technical cybersecurity teams while remaining actively involved in complex technical work.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work flexible hours aligned with U.S. business needs.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting or leading cybersecurity tabletop exercises (TTXs).

  • Experience with organizational-level threat modeling and advanced threat research.

  • Experience integrating AI-powered automation into cybersecurity operations.

  • Experience managing cybersecurity service delivery in a consulting or managed security services environment.

  • Familiarity with modern security monitoring, investigation, and incident response tools.

Location Requirements

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States and internationally.

Top preferred location: Belfast, Northern Ireland.

Additional preferred locations include:

Argentina, Poland, Italy, Romania , Netherlands, Spain, Portugal.

Candidates from other locations may also be considered based on relevant experience and qualifications.

All candidates must be able to accommodate working hours aligned with U.S. business operations.

Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be recognized for the value you bring to our business, along with:

  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career;
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you; and
  • A collaborative environment where everyone works together to create a better working world

If this seems intriguing to you, please apply! We will reach out promptly to discuss your fit and additional job details.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an AI/ML & MLOps Engineer to lead the architecture, deployment, monitoring, automation, and governance of production machine learning capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This SME-level position will maintain training, validation, and testing datasets; design and operate production ML architectures; automate model deployment; monitor model performance and drift; and control updates to models, datasets, pipelines, and supporting configurations. The engineer will establish reproducible, traceable, and secure processes for moving machine learning capabilities from development through validation and into production.

The AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will work closely with mission owners, data scientists, data engineers, cloud architects, software developers, cybersecurity personnel, testers, and operations teams. The successful candidate must combine advanced machine learning engineering knowledge with production automation, secure cloud architecture, data governance, and operational monitoring expertise.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will:

  • Lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and supportable production machine learning architectures.
  • Develop, maintain, and govern training, validation, and testing datasets used for model development and evaluation.
  • Establish repeatable processes for dataset ingestion, preparation, transformation, labeling, validation, versioning, and approval.
  • Ensure datasets are maintained in or transformed into analysis-ready and model-ready formats.
  • Implement controls for dataset quality, completeness, integrity, provenance, lineage, security, and authorized use.
  • Design and automate end-to-end ML pipelines covering data preparation, training, evaluation, packaging, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
  • Deploy machine learning models into approved cloud, application, analytical, and operational environments.
  • Establish automated model build, test, validation, promotion, deployment, rollback, and recovery procedures.
  • Implement model registries and controlled repositories for model artifacts, dataset versions, code, configurations, dependencies, evaluation results, and approvals.
  • Develop automated tests for model pipelines, data transformations, interfaces, deployment packages, and production behavior.
  • Define model evaluation frameworks, performance thresholds, validation criteria, and release-readiness requirements.
  • Evaluate model accuracy, reliability, robustness, performance, scalability, security, and alignment with documented mission requirements.
  • Implement production monitoring for model performance, data drift, concept drift, inference quality, latency, availability, errors, and resource utilization.
  • Establish thresholds, alerts, escalation paths, and response procedures for model degradation, drift, data-quality issues, and operational failures.
  • Investigate model and pipeline anomalies and coordinate corrective actions with data, application, infrastructure, security, and mission teams.
  • Control updates to production models, datasets, features, pipelines, configurations, and dependencies through documented review and approval processes.
  • Maintain traceability among source datasets, data transformations, model versions, evaluation results, deployment records, and production outcomes.
  • Develop rollback and recovery procedures for models, datasets, pipelines, and supporting services.
  • Support secure data pipelines used for AI development, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and operational decision support.
  • Implement technical controls supporting model and data governance, including version control, separation of environments, approval gates, auditability, and change management.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation covering model purpose, training data, evaluation methods, limitations, dependencies, approvals, changes, performance, and known risks.
  • Support the evaluation and auditing of model outputs to identify inaccurate, unsupported, or unexpected results.
  • Help establish human-review checkpoints and escalation procedures for model outputs that could materially affect mission or operational decisions.
  • Support compliance with applicable Government data-handling, cloud-security, cybersecurity, and operational-risk requirements.
  • Integrate model development and deployment workflows with continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and incident-management capabilities.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to address vulnerabilities, access controls, secrets management, software dependencies, logging, encryption, and authorization requirements.
  • Coordinate with data warehouse and data engineering teams on data models, metadata, Extract-Transform-Load processes, data quality, and governed access.
  • Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code and design reviews, troubleshooting support, and knowledge transfer.
  • Prepare architecture diagrams, model lifecycle documentation, deployment procedures, monitoring plans, test results, operating guides, and technical reports.
  • Communicate model performance, drift, risks, incidents, corrective actions, and deployment status to technical teams, Government stakeholders, and program leadership.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, engineering, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience leading the architecture of production machine learning systems.
  • Experience designing and operating production ML or MLOps environments.
  • Experience developing and maintaining training, validation, and testing datasets.
  • Experience establishing model-evaluation methods, performance measures, validation criteria, and acceptance thresholds.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models into production environments.
  • Experience automating model build, test, deployment, promotion, rollback, or retraining processes.
  • Experience implementing model and data drift monitoring.
  • Experience with model governance and data governance.
  • Experience controlling model, dataset, pipeline, and configuration updates.
  • Experience with cloud-based machine learning platforms or production cloud architectures.
  • Experience implementing model, dataset, code, artifact, and configuration versioning.
  • Experience building or integrating automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous delivery capabilities for machine learning systems.
  • Experience monitoring production model performance, reliability, and operational health.
  • Understanding of secure data pipelines, access controls, audit logging, encryption, secrets management, and software supply-chain security.
  • Ability to establish traceability across datasets, transformations, model versions, evaluation results, deployments, and operational outcomes.
  • Ability to document and communicate model limitations, performance, drift, risks, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate or a comparable machine learning platform certification.
  • Advanced AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or comparable cloud architecture or data engineering certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience operating machine learning capabilities in regulated, controlled, or mission-critical environments.
  • Experience with MLflow, Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Kubeflow, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Experience implementing feature stores, model registries, metadata repositories, experiment tracking, or data-lineage tools.
  • Experience with observability platforms, automated alerting, incident response, and production reliability engineering.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI, explainability, output validation, human oversight, bias evaluation, and model-risk management practices.
  • Familiarity with DoD Impact Level 4 or comparable Government cloud and data-protection requirements.
  • Experience with analytical models, generative AI, retrieval workflows, or agentic AI systems.
  • Experience leading technical teams, architecture reviews, or cross-functional ML delivery initiatives.

Skills

  • Production machine learning architecture.
  • MLOps engineering and lifecycle automation.
  • Model deployment and serving.
  • Training, validation, and testing dataset management.
  • Model evaluation and performance measurement.
  • Model and data drift monitoring.
  • Model, data, and configuration governance.
  • Automated testing and deployment pipelines.
  • Cloud ML platforms and secure data pipelines.
  • Version control, traceability, and audit documentation.
  • Production monitoring and incident troubleshooting.
  • Cybersecurity and access-control implementation.
  • Technical leadership and architecture communication.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with mission, data, software, cloud, security, testing, and operations teams.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

      <title>Vercel: Software Engineer, Backend</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2>
<p><span>Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.</span></p>
<p><span>Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.</span></p></div><h2>About the Role:</h2>
<p>We are seeking a Backend leaning Software Engineer. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, high-performance systems. Leveraging JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, SQL and NoSQL cloud-native databases, and AWS, you will develop innovative solutions for user, group, and membership management while ensuring the highest levels of security and reliability.</p>
<p>If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do:</h2>
<ul>
<li>Enable us to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable services that exceed industry standards and customer expectations.</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale projects with cross-team dependencies.</li>
<li>Collaborate with peer teams to deliver solutions that meet industry standards and customer expectations.</li>
<li>Maintain and operate services at high scale, participating in scheduled on-call rotations to ensure reliability.</li>
<li>Implement identity synchronization and lifecycle management solutions using SCIM and other relevant standards.</li>
<li>Work with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes, etc.) to deliver scalable, high-availability applications.</li>
<li>Build and maintain high-quality enterprise software using TypeScript, REST APIs, and JSON.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About You:</h2>
<ul>
<li>Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node.js.</li>
<li>Strong knowledge of security architecture, LDAP, Active Directory, SAML, SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect and web protocols like XML, SOAP, JSON, and REST.</li>
<li>Familiarity with access control models such as RBAC, ABAC and ReBAC.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience with SQL.</li>
<li>Practical experience developing and improving applications written in Node.js.</li>
<li>Exhibit excellent problem-solving abilities and effective communication skills, especially when collaborating with diverse teams.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Benefits &amp; Compensation:</h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation package, including equity.</li>
<li>Inclusive Healthcare Package.</li>
<li>Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off.</li>
<li>We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.</li>
</ul>
<p>The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000-$294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1"><span>#LI-CL1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Disclosures:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Privacy: </strong>Please review our <span><a href="https://vercel.com/legal/job-applicant-privacy-notice">Job Applicant Privacy Policy</a></span> for more information on how we handle your data.</li>
<li><strong>Equal Opportunity:&nbsp;</strong>Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.</li>
</ul></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vercel-software-engineer-backend">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vercel-software-engineer-backend</a></p>

      <title>Maven Clinic: Client Success Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com</p>
<p><strong>An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –&nbsp; Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)</li>
<li>Fortune Change the World (2024)</li>
<li>CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)</li>
<li>Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
</ul></div><p>Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.&nbsp; You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role,&nbsp; it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio</li>
<li>Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth.</li>

<div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3>
