      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>

<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$165,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$185,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

      <title>Tailscale: Analytics Engineer, Data</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (Canada)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.&nbsp;<em>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em>We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p>
<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span>About the Role</span></h3>
<p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints.</li>
<li>Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition).</li>
<li>Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization.</li>
<li>Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.</li>
<li>Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.</li>
<li>High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.</li>
<li>Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.</li>
<li>Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.</li>
<li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Our Tech Stack</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.</li>
</ul>
<p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">CAN Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$203,680</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$254,600 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li>
<li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li>
<li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li>
<li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li>
<li><strong>Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. </strong>Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.<strong><br></strong></li>
<li><strong>Support for your personal and professional development.</strong> Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration.&nbsp;</strong>Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>A build-your-own home office setup. </strong>You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Paid parental leave program</strong>. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.</em></p>
<p><em>Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.</em></p>
<p><em>Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit <a href="https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness">https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness</a>.</em></p></div>

Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

","id":"2a55d6c9-c564-443a-be3e-a3851db5a93b","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

","id":"f7eb82ce-b57e-4dc0-b84a-7f7ec05bf66e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Be the primary liaison, internal advocate and thought leader representing Spotify with a specific focus on key C-Level relationships, in partnership with the Sales leadership team in France.
  • Design and negotiate commercial frameworks (incentive structures, commitments, preferred partner terms), key initiatives and areas of focus that align with Spotify solutions to drive innovation, data activation, insights, research and audio engagement
  • Own agency contact mapping, business reviews, education plans, and communication across assigned agencies 
  • Partner with Agency Commercial, Activation, and Product teams to accelerate adoption of Spotify's automation, self-service, and programmatic buying solutions — ensuring commercial strategy and execution are aligned to prioritized business goals.
  • Ensure strategic alignment across the FR sales org on agency priorities, partnership terms, and key commercial developments — acting as the connective tissue between agency partners and internal teams.
  • Own the commercial narrative across the agency portfolio — tracking revenue trends, spending patterns, and emerging client opportunities to inform partnership strategy and proactively recommend corrective measures to global, regional, and local sales leadership.
  • Structure and develop a strategic agency narrative — grounded in emerging areas like Ads Manager, programmatic, measurement, data collaboration, AI-enabled workflows, and evolving agency operating models — to drive growth and adoption of Spotify's portfolio of solutions across our holding company partnerships.

    Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

    At Spotify, our Subscriptions organisation helps listeners discover the value of Spotify, find the right subscription, and keep enjoying the content they love. From acquisition and activation to retention, commerce, and customer service, we build experiences that connect listeners with Spotify and support lasting relationships.

    We're looking for an Engineering Manager II to lead a team of data and backend engineers within our Subscriptions Mission. Your team will build data products, pipelines, and services that help teams understand listener needs and deliver more relevant experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, data scientists, business partners, and engineers to turn complex challenges into reliable solutions. You'll also create an environment where engineers can grow, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact.

    ","id":"9eeb10f9-6b63-4113-95dd-137519120084","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Lead, support, and develop a team of data and backend engineers, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and grow.

    • Work with product managers, business partners, and engineering teams to set priorities and build data products that improve the subscription experience.

    • Guide the development of reliable, scalable data pipelines and backend services that support targeting, messaging, personalisation, and machine learning.

    • Help your team make informed technical decisions, balancing data quality, reliability, business needs, and long-term maintainability.

    • Support engineers through regular feedback, coaching, career development, and opportunities to share knowledge.

    • Collaborate across teams to manage dependencies, solve challenges, and build shared data solutions.

    • Improve engineering practices, including service reliability, sustainable on-call processes, and responsible data management.

    • Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to simplify workflows, improve data quality, and support your team's work.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have experience leading data or backend engineering teams and enjoy helping engineers develop their skills and careers.

    • You have a background in software or data engineering and can guide technical discussions about data architecture, distributed systems, scalability, and reliability.

    • You understand how to balance team development, technical decisions, and delivery priorities to achieve meaningful results.

    • You have worked with large-scale data pipelines, data platforms, or backend services. Experience with technologies such as Google Cloud, BigQuery, Apache Beam, Dataflow, dbt, Flyte, Airflow, Scala, or Java is valuable.

    • You can navigate changing priorities, make informed decisions, and help your team move forward when the path isn't always clear.

    • You communicate clearly and build effective partnerships with product, business, and engineering teams to turn shared goals into practical solutions.

    • You value different perspectives, encourage open feedback, and help create an environment where people feel respected and supported.

    • You're curious about new technologies, including AI and automation, and enjoy finding ways to improve how teams work and deliver value.

  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

    • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

    • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

    • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

    • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

    • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

    • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

    • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You bring 8+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong visual storytelling, brand identity, and motion design.

    • You have 4+ years of experience leading creative teams, with a thoughtful approach to coaching, feedback, and helping others develop their craft.

    • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

    • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

    • You know how to balance creative ambition with practical delivery, making thoughtful decisions around timelines, budgets, and resources.

    • You communicate creative ideas clearly and enjoy collaborating with designers, producers, and partners across different disciplines and regions.

    • You have experience working with external creative studios, production companies, and partners, including managing budgets, contracts, and production workflows.

    • You care about creating an inclusive, supportive team environment where different perspectives are valued, feedback is welcomed, and people can do their best work.

    Spotify's Legal team is growing. We're facing innovative challenges that mirror the groundbreaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we've expanded into more than 180 markets and our business has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day — including an increasing volume of patent disputes alongside the copyright and content matters that have always been central to our work.

    As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them. The work we face is constantly developing, and the workload is growing faster than we can, so we will look to you to think thoughtfully about processes and policies that will help meet our goals. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial. Significant e-discovery experience and experience conducting confidential inquiries are a plus.

    ","id":"8d54dd6d-d7e0-4298-b051-423bcec4089e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.
  • Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes.
  • Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives.
  • Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment.
  • Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation.
  • Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others.
  • Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement.
  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

  • You have experience with e-discovery and managing complex, multi-jurisdictional disputes.
  • You have experience contributing to teams that drive successful outcomes on complex matters.
  • You have a demonstrated ability to evaluate copyright claims, work with technical experts, and develop defense strategies.
  • You have a passion for solving legal problems and can explain legal concepts — including technical copyright issues — to non-lawyers.
  • You are comfortable working with large data sets and technical subject matter; you may not be an engineer, but you can speak the language and understand the concepts.
  • You are a problem solver who can stay calm when problems come your way.
  • You have excellent judgment — you can think a problem through when you need to, but have also developed instincts that you can trust.
  • You are self-motivated and can identify and complete work that needs to be done without being instructed.
  • You can advocate for a position while balancing risk and multiple colleagues' and business considerations.
  • You can balance many simultaneous tasks and triage to make sure the right matters get your attention.
  • You're willing to roll up your sleeves and dig in on projects.
  • You work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal business partners.
  • You have very effective written and oral communication skills.
  • Knowledge of music, media, tech, IP, and/or consumer issues is a plus.
  • A technical background or experience with software, streaming, or audio technology patents is a plus but not required.

    At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

    Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio.     • Manage the execution of original and licensed content deals, from agreed commercial terms through final contracts, signatures, and close.

    • Prepare clear deal documentation, including term sheets, deal summaries, approval materials, and stakeholder updates.

    • Support the evaluation of new content opportunities through financial models, business cases, and presentations.

    • Monitor content budgets and financial commitments, identify differences against forecasts, and share insights to support informed decisions.

    • Build productive relationships with talent representatives, production companies, and rights holders throughout the deal execution process.

    • You have experience with financial analysis, budget tracking, or financial modeling and can turn data into practical recommendations.

    • You communicate clearly and can explain complex commercial terms to colleagues with different areas of expertise.

    Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

    Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

    Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

    We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

    ","id":"03437e2a-2d5e-4593-9e97-11271014932e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.
  • Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.

    Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

    Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

    Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

    We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

    • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
    • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
    • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
    • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans.     Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
     
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
     
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
     
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
     
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.

    • Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available.

    • Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments.

    • Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation.

    • Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response.

    • Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence.

    • Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight.

    • Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload.

    • Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes.

    • Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

    We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform.     We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration.     We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.

    You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.

    ","id":"9d1c90b5-a8a4-4218-b2f3-7bbaefae7fd1","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
  • Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
  • Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
  • Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
  • Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
  • Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
  • Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
  • Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
  • Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.
  • You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.
  • You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.
  • You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.
  • You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.
  • You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
  • You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.
  • You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.
  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.
  • You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.
  • You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

    We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.

    You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.

    ","id":"7cf725bb-99c8-4717-b7e5-4f4708fa4169","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
  • Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
  • Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
  • Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
  • Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
  • Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
  • Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
  • Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
  • Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.
  • You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.
  • You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.
  • You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.
  • You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.
  • You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
  • You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.
  • You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.
  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.
  • You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.
  • You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.

    As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar.     ","id":"c3f6ea23-97d0-4a9a-a9ad-04f1e745d916","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.

  • You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.

  • You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.

    As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

    ","id":"281e7db9-86ba-4a1c-8773-c23b96ed32dc","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.

    • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.

    • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.

    • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

    • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

    • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

    • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

    • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

    • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.

    • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.

    • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.

    • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.

    • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

    • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.

    • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team

    • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.

    • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.

    • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.
